html.body: Date: 2025-03-26 Remarks This paper is timely filed in response to the final Office Action, dated February 13, 2025, in regard to the above-captioned application.Status of Claims Claim 1-13 are pending. Claim 1 has been rejected under the doctrine of obviousness- type double patenting based on claim 1 of commonly owned U.S. Patent No. 11,760,493.Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration based on the attached Terminal Disclaimer and the following discussion.Applicant gratefully acknowledges the allowability of all pending claims over the prior art of record.Double Patenting In the prior Office Action, Applicant's submitted Terminal Disclaimer was disapproved due to a failure to properly have a suitable power of attorney on file with the Office. Applicant has now corrected this failure and the Office has accepted the Terminal Disclaimer, see attached PTO Record of acceptance. Accordingly, this rejection has been cured. Withdrawal and reconsideration of this rejection is respectfully requested.Conclusion In summary, the above-captioned application is in an allowable condition and an expedited Notice of Allowability is earnestly solicited. Entry under 37 CFR §1.116 is respectfully submitted as this response places no hardship or undue burden upon the Office given that examination of the claims is already complete and the attached Disclaimer obviates the only rejection.If the Examiner wishes to expedite disposition of this matter, the Examiner is invited to contact Applicant's named representative at the telephone number listed below. The Examiner is further authorized to use electronic transmission to contact Applicant's representative at the e- mail address listed below.No fees are due and owing for the timely filing of this paper. However, the Office is herein authorized to deduct any fees, additional fees or extensions of time from Applicant's Deposit Account 50-3010 and to credit any overpayments thereto.Respectfully submitted, BARCLAY DAMON LLP/Peter J. Bilinski/ Date: March 26, 2025 Peter J. Bilinski Attorney for Applicant Reg.
